Friends
921 - The one with the fertility test

Teleplay: Robert Carlock
Story: Scott Silveri
Directed by: Gary Halvorson
Transcribed by: Eleonora, Pheeboh, Sebastiano & Vanessa

[Scene: Central Perk]

Monica: It's so weird, how did Joey end up kissing Charlie last night?
太奇怪了，昨晚乔伊怎么会吻查理呢？ I thought you'd end up kissing Charlie.
我以为你最终会亲吻查理

Ross: Hey, I thought I'd end up kissing Charlie too ok?
嘿，我以为我最终也会亲吻查理，好吗？ But SURPRISE!
但惊喜！

Chandler: I missed most of the party (pause) Charlie's a girl, right?
我错过了聚会的大部分时间（停顿）查理是个女孩，对吧？

Ross: Yes, she is this new professor of my department that I did not kiss.
是的，她就是我系里这位我没有亲过的新教授。

Rachel: I don't know why Joey had to kiss her!
我不知道乔伊为什么要吻她！ I mean, of all the girls at the party, GOD!
我的意思是，在派对上的所有女孩中，天哪！

Ross: Why do you care so much?
你为什么这么关心？

Monica: Yes Rachel, why do you care so much?
是的，瑞秋，你为什么这么关心？

Rachel: (worried) Be-cause Ross is the father of my child!
（担心）因为罗斯是我孩子的父亲！ You know...
你知道... and I...
而我... want him to hook up with lots of women!
想让他勾搭很多女人！ (pause) I just...
（停顿）我只是…… All I'm saying is...
我想说的是... I don't think that Joey and Charlie have anything in common.
我不认为乔伊和查理有任何共同点。

Ross: Oh, I don't know, they seem to have a shared interest in each other's tonsils...
哦，我不知道，他们似乎对彼此的扁桃体有共同的兴趣……

Phoebe: Wow, Joey and a professor!
哇，乔伊和教授！ Can you imagine if they had kids and if the kids got her intelligence and Joey's raw sexual magnetism...
你能想象如果他们有了孩子，如果孩子们拥有她的智慧和乔伊的原始性吸引力…… Oh, those nerds will get laaaaaid!
那些书呆子肯定不愁没性生活！

Rachel: All right, so...
好吧，那么…… Ross, you're ok with all this?
罗斯，你对这一切还满意吗？ I mean...
我是说...

Ross: Yeah, it's no big deal.
是的，没什么大不了的。 I mean, I just met her and I'm fine with it...
我的意思是，我刚刚认识她，我对此很好......

(Joey and Charlie enter. Ross looks at her)

Ross: Oh, God.
哦，上帝。 I forgot how hot she was!
我忘了她有多辣！

Joey: Hey!
嘿！

All: Hi!
你好！

Ross: I'm gonna get some more coffee.
我要再喝点咖啡。

Charlie: Oh, you know what?
哦，你知道吗？ I'll come with you!
我跟你一起去！

Ross: Ok.
好的。 (they both go)

Chandler: (to Joey) So, a professor, uh?
（对乔伊）那么，教授，呃？

Joey: Yeah!
是的！ She is cool, and she's so smart!
她很酷，而且很聪明！ Her mind is totally acrimonious (which, being Joey, he mispronounces "amonious").
她的头脑特别“尖酸刻薄”。（乔伊把词义弄错，读音也读错了） (pause) That's not how she used it...?
（停顿）她不是这么用的……？

Charlie: (talking to Ross) I feel like I owe you an explanation.
（与罗斯交谈）我觉得我欠你一个解释。 I don't ordinarily go around kissing guys at parties.
我通常不会在聚会上到处亲吻男人。 I'm...
我是... well, I'm kind of embarrassed.
嗯，我有点尴尬。 I really hope you don't think less of me.
我真心希望你不要小看我。

Ross: Uhm no!
嗯不！ Think less of you!
看不起你？ No, I don't think less of you.
不，我并没有小看你。 I mean, you saw someone you liked and you kissed them.
我的意思是，你看到了你喜欢的人并吻了他们。 I mean, those people who like someone and don't kiss them...
我的意思是，那些喜欢一个人却不亲吻他的人... those-those people are stupid, I hate those people.
那些——那些人很愚蠢，我讨厌那些人。

Charlie: You know, actually I'm a little surprised to myself.
你知道，实际上我对自己有点惊讶。 I mean, Joey is so different from the guys I usually date.
我的意思是，乔伊与我通常约会的人非常不同。 I mean, they're all professors, and intellectuals, and paleontologists mostly, you know, very cerebral...
我的意思是，他们都是教授、知识分子，而且大多数都是古生物学家，你知道，非常有头脑......

Ross: Yeah, I know the type.
是的，我知道类型。

Joey: Hey, if you wanna grab a bite before work we'd better get acrimonious.
想上班前吃点东西的话，我们最好“尖酸刻薄”起来。 No?
不？ Am I getting close?
我正在接近吗？

Opening credits

[Scene: Joey and Rachel's apartment]

Phoebe: (entering) Hey!
（进来）嘿！

Monica: Hey!
嘿！

Phoebe: Hey you guys!
嘿你们！ Look what I just got.
看看我刚刚得到了什么。 (she shows them a pair of slippers)

Rachel: Oh, OH!
哦，哦！ Wow, I love those!
哇，我喜欢那些！ Where did you get them?
你从哪里得到它们的？

Phoebe: I bought them off Ebay!
我从易趣上买的！ They used to belong to the late Shania Twain.
他们曾经属于已故的仙妮亚·唐恩。

Rachel: (after a pause) Phoebe, Shania Twain is still alive!
（停顿了一下）菲比，仙妮亚·唐恩还活着！

Phoebe: Oh...
哦... then I overpaid.
然后我多付了钱。 (she goes to the bathroom)

Monica: Hey, what's this?
嘿，这是什么？

Rachel: Oh, it's a gift certificate to this new SPA in SOHO.
哦，这是SOHO这家新SPA的礼券。

Monica: Oh, you can't show Phoebe this!
哦，你不能给菲比看这个！ She hates those corporate massage chains.
她讨厌那些公司按摩连锁店。

Rachel: Ah, why, now I can't get a massage?
啊，为什么现在不能按摩了？ There are so many things that she disapproves of!
她不赞成的事情实在是太多了！ I can't eat veal, I can't wear fur, I can't go hunting...
我不能吃小牛肉，我不能穿毛皮，我不能去打猎......

Monica: Do you wanna go hunting?
你想去打猎吗？

Rachel: Well, I would like to have the option!!
好吧，我想有这个选择！

Phoebe: (coming back from the bathroom) What's up?
（从卫生间回来）怎么了？ (she sees the gift certificate in Rachel's hands) Hey, Rachel!!
（她看到瑞秋手中的礼券）嘿，瑞秋！

Rachel: Oh!
哦！

Phoebe: No, you can't go there!
不，你不能去那里！ You know how I feel about these "big massage places"!
你知道我对这些“大按摩场所”的感受吗！ They're putting people like me out of business!
他们让像我这样的人失业！

Monica: And she wants to go hunting, too!!
她也想去打猎！

Rachel: Phoebe, come on, I don't wanna waste it!
菲比，来吧，我不想浪费它！ It would be like throwing away a hundred bucks!
这就像扔掉一百块钱一样！

Phoebe: Ok, this is not about the MONEY, ok?
好吧，这不是钱的问题，好吗？ It's about...
这是关于... it's about corporate greed destroying our hearts and leaving us...
这是关于企业的贪婪摧毁我们的心并离开我们...... the hollow shells.
只剩下空洞的躯壳。

Rachel: I don't care about any of that!!
这些我都不关心！！

Phoebe: Well, do you care about friendship?
那么，你在乎友谊吗？

Rachel: Oh!
哦！

Phoebe: I feel really strongly about this, Rachel.
我对此感觉非常强烈，瑞秋。 Please, don't use this gift certificate.
请不要使用此礼券。 I'm asking you as a friend.
我以朋友的身份问你。

Rachel: Oh, not as a friend, Phoebe!!
哦，不是作为朋友，菲比！ Fine, I won't use it!
好吧，我不会用！

Phoebe: Promise?
承诺？

Rachel: I promise.
我保证。

Phoebe: Thank you.
谢谢。 (she tears up the gift certificate)

Rachel: But I am going hunting!!
但我要去打猎！！

[Scene: Monica and Chandler's apartment]

Monica: (entering) Hey honey!
（进来）嘿，亲爱的！ I missed you today!
今天我想你了！

Chandler: Oh, yeah?
哦，是吗？

Monica: Yeah.
是的。 (they kiss) What d'you wanna do tonight?
（他们接吻）今晚你想做什么？

Chandler: Oh, well...
那好吧... Maybe we could...
也许我们可以... (he sweeps the stuff off the table and wordlessly invites Monica to have sex on it)

Monica: Ok, trying to turn me on by making a mess?
把这里弄乱，是想勾起我的性欲？ Know your audience!
了解你的观众！ Besides, tomorrow we're doing those fertility tests and until then you need to keep your tadpoles in the tank.
明天要做生育检查，在那之前，你得把“小蝌蚪”留在池子里。

Chandler: We really need to take those tests?
我们真的需要参加那些测试吗？

Monica: Honey, we've been trying to have a baby for over a year.
亲爱的，我们已经尝试要孩子一年多了。 I think it's a good idea to find out if everything's ok.
我认为最好检查一下是否一切正常。 Just a few routine tests.
只是一些常规测试。

Chandler: But I don't wanna do it in a cup!
但我不想在杯子里做！

Monica: What is the big deal?
有什么大不了的？

Chandler: It's weird!
很奇怪！ In a doctor's office?
在医生办公室？

Monica: It's not ok to do it in a doctor's office but it is ok to do it in a parked car behind a Taco Bell?
在医生办公室里做这件事是不行的，但在停在塔可钟后面的车里做这件事可以吗？

Chandler: (embarrassed) I cannot believe Ross told you that!
（尴尬）我不敢相信罗斯告诉你这些！ (pause) And in my defense, it was a Wendy's!
（停顿）我得说明，那是温迪餐厅！

Monica: Look, I don't wanna do this test either, but I really do think it's a good idea!
听着，我也不想做这个测试，但我确实认为这是个好主意！

Chandler: Yeah, ok.
是啊，好吧。 I'm sure that doctor's office can't be worst than on a class trip to the Hershey's factory!
我确信医生的办公室不会比班级参观好时工厂更糟糕了！

Monica: (really embarrassed) OH!
（真的很尴尬）哦！

Chandler: Oh, yeah!
哦，是啊！ RACHEL TALKS TOO!
瑞秋也说话了！

[Scene: Joey's apartment]

Joey: (sipping red wine from a glass) Who says that wine has to cost more than milk!
（喝着一杯红酒）谁说酒一定比牛奶贵！

(somebody knocks the door, Joey opens and it's Charlie)

Joey: Heeey!
嘿嘿！

Charlie: Hi!
你好！

Joey: Come on in, how are ya?
进来吧，你好吗？

Charlie: I'm good!
我很好！

Joey: Can I offer you a drink?
我可以请你喝一杯吗？

Charlie: Please, I've been crazed all day!
来一杯吧，我今天忙疯了！ I had a meeting with the Dean, and my syllabus for summer school is due and I'm writing the Foreword for a friend's book...
我与院长会面，我的暑期学校教学大纲即将到期，我正在为朋友的书写前言......

Joey: Uh-oh.
呃哦。 I hade a pretty hectic day at work too, today I had to open a door and go (looking scared) ohhhh!
我也度过了非常忙碌的一天，今天我不得不打开门走（看起来很害怕）哦！

Charlie: So I am just so excited to be here.
所以我很高兴来到这里。 And I can't wait to start exploring the city!
我迫不及待地想开始探索这座城市！

Joey: Hey, if you need a tour guide...
嘿，如果你需要导游... (point to himself)

Charlie: Oh, you mean it?
哦，你是说这个吗？ That would be so fun!
那真是太有趣了！

Joey: Yeah, definitely, definitely.
是的，绝对，绝对。 Ok, what do you wanna see first?
好吧，你想先看什么？

Charlie: Oh, well, we can go see the Chronos Quartet at the Avery Fisher Hall.
哦，好吧，我们可以去艾弗里·费舍尔音乐厅看《时光四重奏》。

Joey: (looking puzzled and nodding) Ok!
（一脸困惑地点点头）好吧！

Charlie: And there is a collection of Walt Whitman letters on display at the public library.
公共图书馆还陈列着沃尔特·惠特曼的信件集。

Joey: I know, yeah!
我知道，是啊！

Charlie: And first, I have to see the MET!
首先，我必须去看大都会艺术博物馆！

Joey: Ok, let me stop you right there.
好吧，让我阻止你。 The Mets suck, ok?
大都会队很糟糕，好吗？ You wanna see the Yankees.
你想看洋基队。

Charlie: No, no, no, not the Mets, the MET, singular!
不是Mets大都会棒球队，是Met，没有s！

Joey: Which one, they all suck!
哪一个，都烂！

Charlie: The museum!
博物馆！

Joey: (looking puzzled) I don't think so.
（一脸困惑）我不这么认为。

[Scene: SPA massage center, Rachel enters]

Rachel: (to the receptionist) Hi there!
（对接待员）您好！

Receptionist: (in an affected tone) Hello, welcome to Lavender Day Spa SPA.
（语气做作）您好，欢迎来到薰衣草日间水疗中心。 How may I help you?
我可以怎样帮助您？

Rachel: Oh, hi.
哦，嗨。 I have a massage appointment under Rachel Green, and here is my gift certificate.
我预约了按摩，名字是瑞秋·格林，这是礼券。

Receptionist: This has been torn up.
这个已经被撕掉了。

Rachel: And...
和... taped back together.
重新粘在一起。

Receptionist: Ok well, I'll call you as soon as your massage therapist is ready.
好的，等您的按摩师准备好后我会立即给您打电话。

Rachel: Ok
好的

Receptionist: Have a seat through the glass doors.
请穿过玻璃门，到里面坐。

Rachel: (imitating the receptionist's tone) through the glass doors.
（模仿接待员）穿过玻璃门。

Receptionist: Through the glass doors.
穿过玻璃门。

Rachel: Alright-y then.
好吧，那么。

(Phoebe enters the hall)

Receptionist: Phoebe, your next client's in the waiting room.
菲比，你的下一个客户在候诊室。

Phoebe: Ok.
好的。 Do we have to talk like that then they're not around?
客人不在的时候，我们还非得这么说话吗？ (She sees Rachel) Oh, no, no!
（她看到瑞秋）哦，不，不！ Listen, is there someone who can fill in for me?
听着，有人可以代替我吗？

Receptionist: Sorry, everyone is booked!
抱歉，大家都被预定了！

Phoebe: But that woman can't know I work here.
但那个女人不可能知道我在这里工作。 She's a friend of mine and I made this big stink about how awful this massage chains are.
她是我的一个朋友，我对这家按摩连锁店的糟糕程度大发雷霆。

Receptionist: Then why you work here?
那你为什么在这里工作？

Phoebe: 'Cause it's good money!
因为钱好赚啊！ But that doesn't change the fact that this is an evil blood sucking corporate machine!
但这并不能改变这是一个邪恶的吸血企业机器的事实！

Receptionist: Well, I think this is a great place to work!
嗯，我认为这是一个工作的好地方！

Phoebe: (watching around and whispering) Ok, are they listening?
（环顾四周并小声）好吧，他们在听吗？

[Scene: Central Perk]

(Joey walks in and moves towards Ross, who's sitting of the sofa)

Joey: Ross!
罗斯！

Ross: Hi!
你好！

Joey: I need to talk to you about Charlie.
我需要和你谈谈查理的事。

Ross: (annoyed) Oh, do you, do you really?
（生气）哦，你，你真的吗？

Joey: Yeah, I'm...
是的，我是... I'm kind of having a little problem.
我有点小问题。

Ross: Look, if you don't know what the word "acrimonious" means, just don't use it!
看，如果你不知道“尖酸刻薄”这个词是什么意思，就不要使用它！

Joey: No, look, you know Charlie, right?
不，听着，你认识查理，对吧？ She's cool, she's funny, her body is soo...
她很酷，她很有趣，她的身体太棒了……

Ross: Get to the problem!
解决问题！

Joey: Yes.
是的。 It's just that she's so much smarter than all the girls I've ever dated!
只是她比我约会过的所有女孩都聪明得多！ Combined!
她比我交往过的所有女孩加起来还聪明！ I don't want her to think I'm stupid!
我不想让她觉得我很傻！

Ross: (looking down) Are you wearing two belts?
（低头）你系两条皮带吗？

Joey: (checking) EH, what do you know!
（检查）呃，你知道什么！

Ross: You were saying you didn't want to seem stupid.
你说你不想显得愚蠢。

Joey: Right, right, right, well, she wants to go to all this cultural places and I don't know how to talk about that stuff.
对，对，对，好吧，她想去所有这些文化场所，但我不知道如何谈论这些东西。 You gotta help me out!
你一定要帮我！

Ross: You know, I really don't want to get involved in you guy's relationship.
你知道吗，我真的不想卷入你们的关系。

Joey: Please, c'mon, you're the smartest person I know and I really like this girl, ok, I don't wanna lose her.
拜托，拜托，你是我认识的最聪明的人，我真的很喜欢这个女孩，好吧，我不想失去她。

Ross: (after a short hesitation) Fine.
（短暂的犹豫后）好吧。

Joey: Thanks.
谢谢。

Ross: Ok.
好的。 Let's see.
让我们来看看。 Oh, you should take her to the MET!
哦，你应该带她去MET！

Joey: The Metsss!
大都会棒球队！

Ross: Oh, no!
哦，不！ The MET!
大都会博物馆！ The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
大都会艺术博物馆。

Joey: (realizing) Oh, that's what she meant!
（意识到）哦，这就是她的意思！ (pause) You know, if they're gonna shorten it, they should call it the MUSE!
（停顿）你知道，如果他们要缩短它，他们应该称其为缪斯！ You know, short for museum, and avoid all the confusion!
你知道，博物馆的缩写，避免所有的混乱！

Ross: Yeah, most of it it's a place packed with confused angry baseball fans!
是的，大部分都是一个充满困惑和愤怒的棒球迷的地方！

Joey: Ok, all right, so I'll take her to the MET.
好吧，好吧，那我带她去MET。

Ross: Yeah, uh, uh, ok, there's this great rare bookstore on Madison Avenue.
是的，呃，呃，好吧，麦迪逊大道上有一家很棒的珍本书店。 You know what?
你知道吗？ She loves architecture, you know what you should do?
她热爱建筑，你知道你应该做什么吗？ You should take a walk down fifth to the Saint Patrick's Cathedral and there there's this great little pastry shop that she'd love.
你应该沿着第五大道步行到圣帕特里克大教堂，那里有一家她很喜欢的很棒的小糕点店。

Joey: Geez, sounds like you should be going on this date!
天啊，听起来你应该去这个约会！

Ross: But I'm not!
但我不是！ (pause).
（暂停）。 You know what if you're in the mood for Thai food...
你知道如果你想吃泰国菜怎么办...

Joey: Whoa, whoa, whoa!
哇哇哇！ Slow down, you go way too fast. Ok?
慢点，你走得太快了。好的？ Just go back to the MET, ok?
直接回MET去吧，好吗？

Ross: Ok.
好的。

Joey: You got to tell me exactly what to do there.
你必须准确地告诉我去那里做什么。

Ross: Ok, when you walk in the museum, take the right, that's the antiquities wing.
进博物馆后右转，就是古代文物展区。 Ancient Egypt, Mesopotamia, up to the Byzantine Empire.
古埃及、美索不达米亚，一直到拜占庭帝国。

Joey: Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa!
哇、哇、哇、哇、哇！ So, I walk in the door and make the right (and he bends his arm to the left. Ross then bends Joey's arm to the right and Joey nods)
所以，我走进门并向右转（他将手臂向左弯曲。然后罗斯将乔伊的手臂向右弯曲，乔伊点点头）

[Scene: doctor's waiting room]

Chandler: I have a weird feeling about this place.
我对这个地方有一种奇怪的感觉。 (pause) How do I know that they are not gonna secretly videotape me and put it all over the internet.
（停顿）我怎么知道他们不会偷偷地给我录像并把它放到互联网上。

Monica: Because, honey, I mean this in the sweetest way possible, nobody is gonna wanna watch that.
因为，亲爱的，我的意思是尽可能以最甜蜜的方式，没有人会想看这个。

(a nurse walks in)

Nurse: Mr. Bing?
宾先生？ (Chandler jumps up) Here you are!
（钱德勒跳起来）给你！ You'll go into that room and deposit your specimen into the container.
您将进入该房间并将样本放入容器中。

Chandler: Deposit my specimen?
存放我的样本吗？ You know, usually I have to call a 900 number for that kind of talk.
你知道，通常我必须拨打 900 号码才能进行此类谈话。 Thanks, got it.
谢谢，明白了。

Monica: Hey, honey, my test is down the hall, are you sure you're going to be ok?
亲爱的，我的检查在走廊那头，你一个人真的没问题？

Chandler: Yeah, I guess!
是的，我想！

Monica: I know this is embarrassing, but nobody cares!
我知道这很尴尬，但没人在乎！ No one here even knows you!
这里根本没有人认识你！

Janice: OH MY GOD!!
我的天啊！！

Chandler: Oh, Come on!
哦，来吧！

Commercial Break
